title: Grill — Pipeline picker in the Git-integration launch modals (round 2)
mode: structured question tool, follow-up to the round-1 override on the manage row

questions.question: You chose to add "Manage pipelines…". In these dialogs that action must close the PipelinePicker, the issue/PR task dialog, and GitHubDialog before navigating to the Pipelines page — the page is a full `view` swap and would otherwise render underneath the still-open Git dialog. Closing those dialogs unmounts the task dialog, so the prompt, references, task type, worktree picks, and selected pipeline are discarded. How should the manage row handle that?

options.label: Confirm only when dirty (Recommended)
options.description: If the user has typed a prompt, attached references, changed task type/worktree, or selected a pipeline, show a discard confirm ("Discard this task draft and open Pipelines?"); otherwise close both dialogs and navigate immediately. Safer against accidental clicks.

options.label: Close and navigate immediately
options.description: Close the picker, the issue/PR task dialog, and GitHubDialog, then navigate to the Pipelines list. No confirmation; an accidental click loses the in-progress prompt and attachments.

options.label: Omit manage row after all
options.description: Revert to no manage row in these two dialogs; users manage pipelines from the header Pipelines button and New Task's picker. Avoids draft loss and the callback/navigation wiring entirely.

options.label: Navigate behind open dialog
options.description: Navigate to the Pipelines page without closing the Git dialog and try to restore it on return. Not recommended: the full-page view would render underneath the stacked dialog, and preserving the draft is much larger than this change.
